description: Future fine-tuning change-set plan for INSAaf AI V2. DO NOT overwrite V1 dataset (server/fineTuneData/). Add new training examples alongside existing V1 entries to support F12-F18 features.

v1_coverage.domains: Constitution, PPC, CrPC, CPC, PECA, Family, Property, Labour, Consumer, Contract, Evidence, bank/tax/NAB/ATA/ women/environment/juvenile/police/succession/commercial/ elections/local/ip/prisons/traffic/arbitration/competition/provincial/immigration
v1_coverage.formats: Single-turn legal Q&A, statutory interpretation, procedural explanations

v2_additions.rationale: V1 only covers single-turn Q&A. The agent handles multi-turn conversations, directory lookups (lawyers/orgs), route intents, and emergency actions.
example_types: Multi-turn agent conversation (user asks for lawyer → agent narrows by city/spec → returns directory card)
Route-intent queries ("I need to file a case" → agent suggests Drafting tab)
Emergency triage ("I'm being threatened" → agent shows emergency contacts + next steps)
Directory search: lawyer by city + specialization with honest fee note
Directory search: legal-aid organization by domain

v2_additions.rationale: V1 may include source mentions but not the new compact format with domain tags.
example_types: Response with domain-mapped library link target
Response distinguishing official source from general reference

v2_additions.rationale: V1 has case-law chunks in RAG but the model may not cite them compactly or hedge comparisons.
example_types: Case comparison with hedging: "The facts in {Case A} are similar to your situation in that both involve {X}, but the court in {Case A} emphasized {Y} which may not apply here."
Response linking case-law to current user query with "may apply"/"could be relevant" qualifiers

v2_additions.rationale: V1 may give flat answers. V2 should structure responses using the 10-step guidance framework.
example_types: Structured response: (1) The issue, (2) Facts that matter, (3) Law that may apply, (4) Relevant authority/court, (5) What to do now, (6) Documents/evidence needed, (7) Available remedy/procedure, (8) Limitations/risks, (9) Next step, (10) Source
Response with ethical hedging: "may", "could", "should consider", "it is possible that"
Response refusing to overstate certainty: "Based on the limited facts provided, I cannot say definitively whether..."
Response deferring to lawyer: "You should consult a practicing advocate for specific advice on..."

generation_script: server/generateFineTuneDataset.js (to be updated with V2 templates)
constraints: DO NOT delete server/fineTuneData/refs.js or any V1 file
V2 examples should be appended to a NEW file: v2_changeset.jsonl
When fine-tuning is run, combine V1 + V2 datasets
All new examples must reference the verified RAG corpus (rebuild before generating)
No fabricated case names, citations, or facts (use only verified corpus entries)
